summary: Phase 37 frontend-only testing: DRAFT RESUME, chapter reorder in detail drawer, material move in detail drawer, and platform bulk upload — all verified live. Created a fresh draft on Grade 10 · Mathematics as teacher prasad27 (ai-create-curriculum-btn → wizard with textbook upload qa_tb_g10.txt + chapters 'QA Chapter 1' and 'QA Chapter 2' + Finish later via ai-wiz-save-draft), returned to teacher view which correctly rendered DRAFT badge + Edit/resume (ai-edit-draft-btn). Clicking resume reopened the wizard pre-filled: name='QA Draft Resume G10', syllabus prefilled, step 1 showed existing-textbook pill [data-testid=ai-wiz-existing-textbook] containing the uploaded filename 'qa_tb_g10.txt', Next:Chapters was ENABLED (no re-upload demanded). Edited name to 'QA Draft Resume G10 EDITED' and clicked ai-create-submit → curriculum status changed to PENDING, name persisted across page reload. Chapter reorder: Grade 8 Mathematics detail drawer — before order [Algebra, Geometry, Phase 31 Demo, Linear Equations]; clicked ai-detail-chapter-down-0 → after order [Geometry, Algebra, Phase 31 Demo, Linear Equations]. Material move: selected ai-item-move-<id> dropdown for 'Algebra basics' notes from Chapter 1: Algebra → Chapter 2: Geometry; reloaded page and the material now renders under Chapter 2: Geometry with select value persisted. Bulk upload: /platform/library → lib-bulk visible, selected 3 TXT files (lib-bulk-files) → 3 rows (lib-bulk-row-0/1/2); set quick-tag Grade 7 + subject 'QA Bulk Subject' + type notes and Apply-to-all (lib-bulk-apply-all) → row 0/2 inherited (grade=Grade 7, subject=QA Bulk Subject, type=notes, title=qa_bulk_0/2); per-row override on row 1 title='QA Bulk Row1 Override' + type=worksheet honored; clicked lib-bulk-submit → all 3 appear PUBLISHED in Library list and under Grade 7 filter.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: visual-editor instrumentation injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> (React warns span cannot be child of option). No functional impact — carried over from prior iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: AITutorTeacher.jsx — the live Grade 9 draft left by a prior iteration had NO textbook item (its tbItem was undefined), so step1ok evaluated to false and Next:Chapters stayed disabled in Edit mode; the fallback UX simply demanded a file. This happens because the draft was created when the textbook upload itself failed. Minor hardening suggestion: when `isEdit && !existingTextbook`, surface a small inline hint 'No textbook saved on this draft — upload one to continue' instead of silently keeping Next disabled.

Chapter reorder in detail drawer works, but the two preview-only /api requests fired during drawer rendering return 403 for the teacher role (visible in console). Doesn't block the flow but is noisy — consider gating these fetches to roles that can view them.
